overviewParagraphs: Alpine Golf & Sports Club holds a place in history that few courses in Asia can match — it was here in 1997, on a course of remarkable natural topography, that a young Tiger Woods won the Johnnie Walker Classic and announced to the world that Thai golf was ready for a global stage.

Set in Bangkok's green lung north of the city, Alpine commands unusual terrain for a Bangkok course: genuine elevation changes, forested ridges, and dramatic hill-to-valley transitions that reward careful course management. The layout challenges all classes of player, with narrow tree-lined corridors demanding accuracy off the tee and fast, undulating greens demanding patience on every approach.

For discerning golfers with an appreciation for tournament history and genuine course character, Alpine Golf & Sports Club is essential. AGS can build Bangkok itineraries pairing it with the city's other elite facilities for a thoroughly satisfying northern Thailand golf experience.

curatorBriefHtml: Alpine Golf Club Bangkok (opened 1996 by Ron Garl in Pathum Thani, roughly 50–60 minutes north of central Bangkok) is Thailand’s most famous tournament-pedigree private club — immortalized by Tiger Woods’s 2000 Johnnie Walker Classic victory. Playing 7,007 yards (Par 72), Garl engineered dramatic man-made hills, tight tree-lined corridors, island-style water hazards, and lightning-fast contoured greens that set it completely apart from Bangkok’s otherwise flat delta terrain.

Because Alpine operates as a strictly private members’ club, visitor tee times are tightly controlled — particularly on weekends. Securing weekday access through AGS unlocks one of Asia’s most coveted scorecards, where sharp iron control and confident putting on slick sloped greens separate good rounds from great ones.
AGS integrates Alpine Golf Club into The Bangkok & Hua Hin Fairways and The Indochina Golden Age, pairing it seamlessly with Thai Country Club and Nikanti.

scorecard.verdict: The venue where Tiger Woods conquered the Johnnie Walker Classic. Ron Garl transformed flat Bangkok plains into a heavily contoured parkland masterpiece with severe undulating greens and rolling hills.

faqs.q: Can visiting golfers play the private Alpine Golf Club Bangkok?
faqs.a: Walk-in bookings are not accepted, and weekend play is members-only. Asia Golf Specialists arranges pre-confirmed weekday visitor tee times (Tuesday–Friday) as part of bespoke Bangkok itineraries.

faqs.q: How far is Alpine Golf Club from downtown Bangkok?
faqs.a: Plan for 50 to 65 minutes north of central Bangkok (Sukhumvit / Riverside) by private touring vehicle, departing around 06:30–07:00 AM to beat morning city traffic.

faqs.q: What makes Alpine Golf Club Bangkok so famous?
faqs.a: Ron Garl created unusual hilly mounding on Bangkok’s flat plains, paired with lightning-fast undulating greens and dramatic water-framed finishing holes — famously hosting Tiger Woods’s 2000 Johnnie Walker Classic win.

faqs.q: When is the prime season to play Alpine Golf Club?
faqs.a: November through February brings cooler, drier Bangkok mornings (24–31°C). From March to October, early 07:00–08:00 AM tee times beat midday tropical heat.
